# Joyous Montessori

> Joyous Montessori is a Montessori-based early childhood education and childcare center located in Keller, Texas. The school provides infant, toddler, preschool, enrichment, and summer programs in a nurturing learning environment.

## Official Website

- https://joyousmontessori.com/ — Official website and overview of Joyous Montessori.
- https://joyousmontessori.com/about-us — About the school, its educational approach, and learning environment.
- https://joyousmontessori.com/our-programs — Overview of the school's education and care programs.
- https://joyousmontessori.com/keller-montessori-programs — Information about Montessori programs and learning experiences in Keller.
- https://joyousmontessori.com/daycare-programs-in-keller-tx — Information about daycare and early learning in Keller.
- https://joyousmontessori.com/enroll — Enrollment and admissions information.
- https://joyousmontessori.com/contact-us — Official contact information and campus location.

## Programs

Joyous Montessori's published programs include:

- Infant Program — Care and age-appropriate early learning for infants from approximately 6 weeks.
- Pre-Toddler Program — Early Montessori experiences for children from approximately 18 months.
- Transitional Toddler Program — Activities that support independence, practical life skills, language, and social development.
- Primary Class — Montessori learning for young children, including language, mathematics, practical life, sensorial learning, and cultural studies.
- Enrichment Programs — Activities listed by the school include Spanish, music and movement, yoga, computer lab, gymnastics, sports skill development, book club, gardening, and cooking.
- Summer Programs — Themed summer activities and hands-on learning experiences.

For current age eligibility, availability, schedules, and enrollment details, refer to the official program and enrollment pages or contact the school.

## Montessori Approach

The school describes its approach as child-focused and hands-on. Its published materials emphasize learning at each child's pace, exploration, independence, practical life activities, sensorial experiences, language, mathematics, and guidance from educators.

## Service Area

The school's website identifies Keller, Texas, and nearby communities including Southlake, Westlake, Colleyville, North Richland Hills, and Fort Worth.
